natalie (DevEx): FYI ran into a confusing onboarding failure: sample-app kept spinning on auth and support tickets show users confused by vague SDK errors. can we standardize error shape?

raj (SDK): can you show an example?

natalie (DevEx): server returned 403 with body `{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"reason\":\"org quota exceeded\"}`. Node SDK surfaced `Error: 403` with message 'Request failed' and no structured fields. sample-app tried to parse message text and missed the quota reason.

anya (sample-app): result: users see a generic modal "Something went wrong" and re-try button. They retry and hit another quota error or get blocked. onboarding drop is higher.

raj (SDK): agreed we should ship typed exceptions across SDKs. proposal: every SDK error includes fields: `code` (string enum), `status` (int), `message` (string), `details` (string list), `hint` (string), `is_retryable` (bool), `meta` (map) — though map can't be in Slack, but idea is flexible metadata.

mike (eng): prefer small stable surface. suggest: `code`, `status`, `message`, `hint`, `is_retryable`. Keep `code` values stable: ERR_AUTH, ERR_PERM, ERR_RATE_LIMIT, ERR_QUOTA, ERR_VALIDATION, ERR_INTERNAL.

tom (Docs): docs note: map HTTP 403 to ERR_PERM by default, but if server returns `reason:quota` or `quota_exceeded` then map to ERR_QUOTA and set `is_retryable=false` and `hint` -> server's quota message. Also call out that 401 with scope messages should NOT trigger silent refresh unless `retryable=true`.

raj (SDK): implementation note: do not change HTTP codes or break existing users. Add `error.code` field in response body and have SDK surface `err.code` as string. Backwards compat: SDKs will keep legacy `message` parsing for one release.

natalie (DevEx): tests: can we add a small e2e that mocks API returning `{}`
